vision: Build a plan-driven bug attribution agent with internal governance. The system separates concerns into three pipelines: (1) Input Pipeline — deterministic extraction and candidate retrieval at zero LLM cost; (2) Agent Pipeline — LLM plans, examines, and attributes within an InvestigationBrief, governed by an investigation harness with rules and skills; (3) Evaluation Pipeline — oracle scores output. The agent receives a CandidateSet (not raw repo access), operates within completion criteria (not just budget), produces structured InvestigationTraces for learning, and improves over time via skills derived from traces. Evaluated via Hit@k, MRR, D3, D6, and Retrieval Recall against ApacheJIT ground truth.
direction: V4.2 + P29 blame bonus at Hit@5=0.700, MRR=0.416 (current best). Recall@15=20/20, all cases reach shortlist. 6 remaining misses: GROOVY-7014 (rank 8, P30 triage anchor), GROOVY-8298 + HIVE-4113 + IGNITE-6748 (investigation failures), IGNITE-2158 + GROOVY-8416 (stochastic regressions). Strategy: (1) P30 triage anchor for GROOVY-7014, (2) P31 investigation prompt improvements, (3) P32 validation eval. Expected ceiling: Hit@5=0.750-0.800 with targeted fixes.

invariants.temporal_bound: Temporal bound (COMMIT_B~1) constrains the ENTIRE system — input pipeline retrieval and agent tools. In eval mode, bound comes from fix_hash.
invariants.llm_reasons_scripts_retrieve: Scripts own retrieval (candidate set assembly) and evidence verification. LLM owns planning, examination reasoning, and attribution.
invariants.agent_is_governed: The investigation harness governs the LLM. The harness manages state, transitions, and completion criteria.
invariants.observable_by_design: Every investigation produces a structured InvestigationTrace. Traces are the substrate for skill emergence.
invariants.ground_truth: GroundTruthGraph provides bug_hash from commit_links.csv. SZZ-based labeling has known noise — Hit@5 is primary metric, not Hit@1.

remaining_misses._note: Failure breakdown of 7/20 misses after P26 (gpt-5.3-codex n=20 eval)

pre_score_failures.diagnosis: GT in candidate set (rescued by localization_blame) but drops below rank 15 in pre-scoring. Root cause: blame-sourced commits with signal_count=1 and low/zero file_overlap score poorly under current formula (0.5*file_overlap + 0.3*norm_sc + 0.2*rank).
pre_score_failures.intervention: Add dedicated blame_bonus to pre-score formula. localization_blame has 87.5% GT precision — it deserves higher weight than a generic +1 signal_count.

triage_failures.diagnosis: GT survives pre-score@20 but ranks 8+ (outside top-7 triage window). Previously these were investigation failures (pre-P26); P26 may have shifted relative rankings by adding more blame-sourced candidates. Blanket triage expansion (P24) regressed by diluting LLM attention.
triage_failures.intervention: Option A: blame_bonus in pre-score pushes them into top 7 naturally. Option B: targeted triage anchor — blame-sourced commits auto-claim watchlist slots (no blanket expansion). Try A first.

investigation_failures.diagnosis: IGNITE-6748 (exam_recall=true, ranked >5): LLM examined GT but failed to rank it highly — reasoning/comparative analysis failure. HIVE-4113 (exam_recall=false): LLM never examined GT despite it being in triaged set — planning/coverage failure. SPARK-23059 (exam_recall=true, ranked >5): same as IGNITE-6748.
investigation_failures.intervention: Harder to fix structurally. Options: (a) investigation prompt improvements for comparative reasoning, (b) forced full-coverage examination before ranking, (c) accept these as stochastic ceiling (~15% LLM variance).

tasks.name: Investigation prompt: forced examination coverage + comparative ranking
tasks.scope: Address the 3 investigation failures: (1) HIVE-4113 (exam_recall=false) — LLM skipped examining GT. Add a coverage rule: 'You MUST call get_commit_diff on every must-examine candidate before concluding.' (2) IGNITE-6748, SPARK-23059 (exam_recall=true, ranked>5) — LLM examined GT but ranked it poorly. Add a comparative analysis step: after examining all candidates, explicitly compare the top N with the strongest evidence before finalizing ranking. Touch: investigation/prompts.py. Verify: no latency regression (budget stays within 300s target).
tasks.note: Investigation improvements are inherently stochastic. Run eval 2x to separate signal from noise. Acceptable if improvement is +1-2 cases with 0 consistent regressions.

tasks.name: Validation eval: n=20 gpt-5.3-codex after P29-P31
tasks.scope: Full n=20 eval with gpt-5.3-codex after pre-score and investigation improvements. Record: Hit@5, MRR, full funnel metrics, per-case results. Run 2x to measure stochastic variance. Target: Hit@5 >= 0.750 (mean of 2 runs). If achieved, run multi-model eval (sonnet, haiku) to validate generalization.

tasks.name: Stochastic variance: majority-vote or temperature-0 investigation
tasks.scope: If P32 validation shows high run-to-run variance (>2 cases), investigate mitigation: (A) temperature=0 for investigation LLM calls (reduces variance at slight quality cost), (B) majority-vote across 3 runs with rank aggregation (3x cost but higher reliability), (C) self-consistency within a single run (ask LLM to re-rank after initial investigation). Spike only — analyze feasibility and cost/benefit. Do NOT build without evaluating cost implications.

gate.decision: One of A/B/C selected with cost/quality tradeoff documented, or determined unnecessary if variance <= 2 cases

tasks.note: Only relevant if stochastic variance remains a problem after P29-P31. May be unnecessary.
